generation_fact: One atomic relation established by an execution: a particular source, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role; it retains those exact identities.
generation_occurrence: One concrete execution, which may establish several generation facts without making those facts interchangeable.
atomic_generation_fact: Every fact remains an indivisible source-transformation-occurrence-outcome-role record even when an occurrence realizes several facts.
realizes_fact: The primitive relation connecting an occurrence node to each exact generation fact that occurrence established.
reads_from: The primitive record of an actual data dependency; it cannot be inferred from execution order, timestamp proximity, or numeric similarity.
GeneratedOrigin: The relation by which an outcome formed earlier participates as the exact source of a later generation fact.
program_order: Declared execution order between occurrences; by itself it establishes no data dependency and proves no concurrency property.
equal_values: Equal numeric values identify neither the same fact, occurrence, or result nor equal formation provenance.
cartesian_recombination: Facts realized by one occurrence must not be split into source and result sets and recombined as a Cartesian product, because that invents unestablished relations.
missing_relations: A missing relation means it was not established in the graph; absence alone does not prove the relation false, and absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: Preserve exact identities along training sample -> batch occurrence -> forward occurrence -> loss -> backward occurrence -> gradient -> optimizer occurrence -> new parameter version, using primitive facts and actual dependency/incidence relations.
reverse_query: Begin at the concrete evaluation or parameter result and traverse its actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations backward; never substitute timestamp proximity or numeric similarity.
executable_claim: The sealed executable mechanism is the scientific authority: the report explains and cites it but cannot replace it, and every causally relevant report variable must be executed or supported by an elimination falsification.
state_sufficiency: Treat state q with declared input a as operationally closed only when equal or sufficiently similar (q,a) cases have compatible (q_next,y_next) behavior within tolerance; search for matched-state divergent futures, omitted evolving variables, and transitions the update law cannot generate, then enlarge or revise state on failure.
prefix_only_falsification: At multiple cuts before, near, and after transitions, initialize using only the graph prefix, predict a withheld later interval without reading it, compare to the recorded suffix, retain failures, and revise or reject the mechanism; a full-run fit is not a substitute.
report_code_correspondence: Map every mechanism claim to exact primitive GFG evidence, an executable state field or justified elimination, and its update-law expression; every executable field must have a defined update or be a prefix-derived frozen constant.
operational_state_use: Field presence, serialization, reporting, or carry-forward is not operational use: identify the exact expression through which each claimed state can change a required forecast and perturb, remove, or hold it fixed in prefix-only replay; relabel no-effect fields diagnostic or revise the law.
intervention_state_audit: For an intervention enumerate all state read or written by the affected operation, determine what the hook changes, freezes, or leaves evolving, propagate each difference through the update law, test on eligible discovery prefixes, and reject pure time translation unless all required state translates consistently.
cross_run_invariance: Separate structural laws, prefix-inferred state, discovery-estimated parameters, and uncertainty; falsify fixed period, amplitude, rate, delay, timestamp, and increment assumptions with multiple prefix cuts and matched-state divergent-future searches. Passing one-run tests only means not falsified there: correct state semantics do not establish a transportable transition law, which must be sealed and prospectively tested on a distinct unseen continuous execution.
